requirements.title: Canonical source hierarchy
requirements.summary: Global architecture, shared contracts, per-skill instructions and executable evidence have explicit precedence.

requirements.title: Explicit exact-head identity
requirements.summary: Candidate-bound evidence remains tied to the material identity it examined and later material writes invalidate dependent evidence.

requirements.title: Fail-closed unknown semantics
requirements.summary: Missing or ambiguous material evidence never becomes implicit approval or fabricated zero.

requirements.title: Bounded remediation and retries
requirements.summary: Implementation, CI and audit remediation are bounded and cannot form open-ended AI-on-AI loops.

requirements.title: Independent read-only audit
requirements.summary: Independent audit is isolated from implementation authority and does not mutate the candidate.

requirements.title: Exclusive CI ownership transfer
requirements.summary: Delivery snapshot and CI remediation ownership are mutually exclusive for the same material SHA and return control structurally.

requirements.title: Progressive context with insufficient-context blocking
requirements.summary: Skills load context progressively but must block semantic approval when required material context is unavailable.

requirements.title: No implicit merge authority
requirements.summary: Skill approval and release readiness never imply native merge enforcement or merge authority.

requirements.title: Canonical shared-contract ownership
requirements.summary: entregar-issue owns shared contracts and generated copies in other skills remain synchronized.

requirements.title: Observable state without fabricated values
requirements.summary: Known zero, known value, partial and unknown remain distinguishable in metrics and operational evidence.

requirements.title: Machine-readable skill catalog
requirements.summary: Every validated skill is registered with purpose, modes, triggers, authority and required capabilities in one catalog.

requirements.title: Generated contract synchronization
requirements.summary: Generated contract copies and files declared in config/shared-files.json are checked against canonical bytes and cannot drift silently.

requirements.title: Documentation reference integrity
requirements.summary: Local Markdown links, skill references and generated catalog documentation remain resolvable.

requirements.title: Fail-closed capability contract
requirements.summary: Skills declare required capabilities and deterministic fallbacks so missing access cannot become implicit success.

requirements.title: Reproducible release versioning
requirements.summary: Public SemVer releases, temporal catalog versions and contract lineage are declared in a compatibility manifest with migration notes.

requirements.title: Portable platform adapters
requirements.summary: Supported AI hosts use one adapter manifest, progressive loading order and host-declared capabilities without assuming provider access.

requirements.title: Behavioral evaluation harness
requirements.summary: Versioned evaluation cases, explicit runtime availability, bounded metrics and hashable reports detect behavioral regressions without replacing deterministic gates.

requirements.title: Adversarial behavioral regression matrix
requirements.summary: The evaluation harness keeps sibling cases and deterministic baselines for selection, authority, capabilities, evidence, context and related fail-closed boundaries.

requirements.title: No unreachable operational files
requirements.summary: Every reference, script and schema shipped by a skill is reachable from its SKILL.md; dead files are deleted instead of left to drift.

requirements.title: Canonical issue specification form
requirements.summary: The issue body that feeds requirement closure has a versioned canonical form: normative sections are declared once, templates stay inert so no placeholder becomes a requirement candidate, and the declaration is cross-checked against the independent audit parser.

requirements.title: Resolved selection is proven, not only abstention
requirements.summary: The behavioral matrix covers resolved skill selection grounded in the real router, keeps the no-match case explicitly unknown, and exercises the persisted replay report in CI.

requirements.title: Enforced context budget
requirements.summary: Control planes and references are bounded by measured bytes per file and characters per line, with an allowance list whose entries must equal the current measurement and therefore can only shrink.

requirements.title: Genericity of permanent assets is enforced
requirements.summary: The genericity validator blocks numbered issue coupling, issue-derived permanent rules, absolute host paths, concrete identifiers in Markdown prose outside delimited examples, and concrete external hosts, and the workflow runs it over the catalog root.

requirements.title: Long references are navigable
requirements.summary: Every reference above the declared byte threshold declares when it should be read and exposes an index whose anchors resolve and whose entries cover every section, so progressive loading can be selective.

requirements.title: Trusted auditor registry has a declared procedure
requirements.summary: The security document declares custody, producer and approver separation, key handling, rotation, revocation and the single-operator limitation, and the registry entry builder derives the fingerprint from the published key and refuses material the schema rejects.

requirements.title: Dependency resolution is reproducible and exceptions are declared
requirements.summary: Every manifest in the repository, including the catalogue tooling manifest at the root, has a sibling lockfile pinning exact versions, the chosen artifact and sha256 hashes of the transitive closure; an offline deterministic validator rejects manifest, lockfile or policy paths that resolve outside the repository root, manifests that are not regular files, lockfiles not paired nominally with a manifest and orphan lockfiles outside the root, drift, unresolvable, non-manifest or out-of-root includes, manifest options it does not implement, lockfile options other than --hash, uninterpretable requirement lines and direct URL references, pinned versions that do not satisfy the declared specifier, missing hashes, artifact declarations whose name, version or distribution grammar do not match the locked resolution, unevaluable environment markers and malformed policy exceptions that do not name an existing locked resolution; version, specifier, requirement, marker and distribution grammar is interpreted by packaging, declared at the root and installed from the root lockfile, so a form the reference implementation of PEPs 440, 508 and 427 refuses fails instead of being approximated, markers are evaluated against the interpreter running the gate rather than the editable context comment, the required sequence also re-resolves the closure and fails when the lockfile is not the closure of its manifest, comparing packages, versions and dependency edges independently of the resolving environment, and the advisory lookup and the digest verification against the real artifact run outside the required sequence and report UNKNOWN instead of success when they cannot verify.

requirements.title: Static analysis is real, declared and impossible to weaken silently
requirements.summary: Python code in the catalogue is checked by a deterministic, offline gate that runs Ruff with a selection derived from a versioned policy and fails on any diagnostic of an applied rule; every rule family in the installed tool catalogue appears exactly once in the policy as applied, partially applied with the disabled part declared, or dismissed with a written reason, so a family added by a tool upgrade or a dismissal without a reason fails the gate and coverage cannot shrink silently; coverage is checked at the rule level, so an applied family with a narrow selection, a partial family that leaves one of its rules undecided, a partial family that disables the whole family and an entry belonging to another family all fail; dismissed and partial entries carry a reason of substantive length and applied entries carry none; the tool version is pinned in the manifest and the lockfile and declared in the policy, and a divergence between installed and declared version fails instead of passing; the gate runs with the declared language target and line length, without cache and without network; inline suppression is accepted only when the code is in the allowed list and the same line carries its own justification after the separator, the scanner reads the forms the tool recognises, including the marker in any case and the file-level directive with a `ruff:` or `flake8:` prefix, a file-level directive without codes is refused, comments are read from real comment tokens so a directive inside a string is not a suppression, and a directive that suppresses nothing fails; the scanned scope is declared in the policy, and a covered file that is a symlink outside the root, an unreadable directory, a directory of the scope that is a symbolic link, a scanned set without any covered file, and a tool output that is empty or malformed fail with an explicit cause instead of shrinking the analysed set or treating emptiness as approval; an inline justification needs its own text after the separator, an entry must carry the exact family prefix rather than a textual prefix and must be written in upper case, a broken or cyclic symbolic link and the disappearance of the tool executable between the version check and the analysis fail instead of approving the tree, and the documented-sequence test compares every workflow step, requiring each one to be classified as validation or declared as non-validation; the repository tree passes clean, and the aggregate validator, the CI sequence, the README and AGENTS.md run the gate in the same position.
